integrity: The proof exhausts primes, prime squares, and squarefree semiprimes. The odd semiprime case is reduced reversibly to \((kt-2)P=k+t+3\), after which a sharp inequality leaves finitely many integer cases. The finite verifier is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only \(n>1\) with \(\Omega(n)\le2\). It does not classify higher multiplicity layers or give an asymptotic for the ambient sequence.
title: Complete \(\Omega\le2\) classification for \(\varphi(n)\mid n\sigma(n)\)
